newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares fall for fifth day in a row.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares fall for fifth day in a row.

text.p: Slovenian shares closed 1.21 percent lower on Thursday on meagre turnover with traders fearing the market could continue its downward trek over the medium term due to a dearth of active investors.
Traders said it was hard to determine at what levels prices would bottom-out due to widespread pessimism on the market -- generated by a clampdown on foreign trading activity last month.

But despite market sentiment festering at a low ebb, traders said good value could be picked up at cheap prices in companies such food producers Droga and Kolinska, drug makers Lek and Krka and bank SKB.
* The SBI index fell 16.21 points to 1,318.15.
* Overall 10 shares fell, three rose and one was unchanged, while 11 were untraded.
* Brokerage Finmedia was the leading decliner, falling 7.69 percent to 12,000 tolars on volume of 86 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
